spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace owner role, account binding, revision and active-writer checks are enforced server-side; busy and stale-revision results require a fresh read before retry.
Candidate identity is resolved from current SpellBook Finance catalog and inventory data. This operation accepts no arbitrary provider listing ID, credential, or physical mapping.
Stopping management does not delist a listing, erase order history, or turn off saved channel automation. This operation never publishes or reprices.
The permission change does not enable automation. Existing automation settings remain unchanged.

description: Change one seller-owned channel's saved listing scope. Read spellbook_inventory_management_get first. Switching legacy all mode to selected mode clears management for all current listings. On an eligible backfilled account, restore_legacy_all explicitly manages every current and future listing on that connected seller account; saved automation settings remain unchanged. In selected mode, use a named candidateId from current SpellBook Finance rows to manage or stop managing a complete listing. Stopping management leaves its live listing and order history intact. These actions save permission for existing automation and do not enable automation or publish a listing.
